name: Captain Calculator
title: Guardian of the Ones & Twos
description: The steady starter hero! Captain Calculator never misses a beat when counting by 1s and 2s.

name: The Fiver
title: Master of the High Fives
description: Zooming in with the power of 5s and 10s, The Fiver counts faster than a rocket!

name: The Multiplier
title: The Doubling Dynamo
description: Nothing stays small around The Multiplier — one becomes many in the blink of an eye!

name: Triple Threat
title: Champion of the Threes
description: Three times the speed, three times the fun. Triple Threat leaps over the 3s with ease!

name: Quad Squad Captain
title: Commander of the Fours
description: Marching in perfect fours, the Quad Squad Captain keeps every number in line.

name: Sixer Sprinter
title: The Speedy Sixster
description: Blazing through the 6s at super-speed, nobody counts faster than the Sixer Sprinter!

name: Lucky Seven
title: The Fortune Flyer
description: With a wink and a whoosh, Lucky Seven turns the tricky 7s into a lucky win!

name: Octo Ace
title: The Eight-Armed Wonder
description: Eight arms, eight answers at once! Octo Ace juggles the 8s without breaking a sweat.

name: Nine Lives Ninja
title: Shadow of the Nines
description: Sneaky, swift, and never stumped — the Nine Lives Ninja masters the mighty 9s.

name: Fraction Falcon
title: The Ultimate Times-Table Titan
description: The legendary top hero! The Fraction Falcon has soared past every table and rules the skies of math.
catchphrase: The sky is not the limit — it's the beginning!
